title: WorkspaceComponentRecord
description: Schema defining a registered workspace component (skill, tool, agent, integration, shared_asset) in the Workspace Governance Catalogue.

id.description: Stable unique kebab-case slug identifying the component.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the component.

purpose.description: Primary role, purpose, and capability summary.

location.description: Relative workspace file path or package/system identifier.

version.description: Version string or semantic release constraint.

version_constraints.description: Permitted version range or runtime requirements.

required.description: Whether explicit manual or automated installation is needed.

dependencies.description: List of component IDs or system packages required.

documentation_urls.description: Official documentation links, reference guides, or upstream repositories.

spdx_identifier.description: SPDX short identifier or license name.

status.description: Audit verification state of license terms.

commercial_use.description: Whether commercial use is permitted without royalties.

notes.description: Specific license terms, restrictions, or exceptions.

requires_filesystem_write.description: Whether component modifies files in workspace.

requires_network.description: Whether component makes outbound network requests.

requires_execution.description: Whether component executes shell processes or binaries.

sensitive_data_exposure.description: Must be false. True indicates security violation.

notes.description: Security considerations, sandboxing, and permission boundaries.

owner.description: Responsible subsystem, team, or agent skill.

approval_evidence.description: Evidence supporting the approval status (e.g. QA gates passed, code review, benchmark).

architecture_ref.description: Reference to relevant section in ARCHITECTURE.md or AGENTS.md.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date of last audit verification (YYYY-MM-DD).
